root_cause_and_implementation: No production code changed -- ReplayVerificationService::verifyRunAgainstFixture() and MarketDataPipelineService were both read in full and found already correct for both the replay and rebuild determinism senses. The defect was entirely in proof binding: B18ReplayRerunDeterminismTest, the guard all four predicates were bound to, calls MarketDataEvidenceExportService::exportReplayEvidence() twice on one static, hand-fabricated md_replay_daily_metrics object -- it never calls ReplayVerificationService::verifyRunAgainstFixture() (the replay sense) or MarketDataPipelineService (the rebuild sense) at all, confirmed by grep across the whole file. Two predicates need the replay sense only (MD-S019-R0073, MD-S005-R0095), one needs the rebuild sense only (MD-S003-R0004), and one needs both (MD-S019-R0009) -- this split is read directly from the contract text (two separate named document sections describing two separate mechanisms), not inferred from a method name. For the rebuild sense, an exploratory throwaway probe (discarded after use, never committed) called runDaily() twice independently for the same unchanged date with no correction request, and observed concrete real behavior: a genuinely new run_id, an identical bars_batch_hash, a sealed-but-never-current second candidate publication, and a HELD/NOT_READABLE/RUN_LOCK_CONFLICT outcome via PublicationFinalizeOutcomeService's existing promotion-safety refusal -- the system already refuses to silently promote an unauthorized second run as a fake correction. Cross-referencing MarketDataPipelineIntegrationTest's existing correction-workflow tests against F-014's predicates (rather than assuming no guard existed) found a pre-existing, already-green, real-SQLite-pipeline positive/negative pair that already proves exactly this for the SUPPORTED rerun path (the explicit correction workflow): test_run_daily_correction_with_unchanged_artifacts_cancels_request_and_preserves_current_publication (unchanged content -> identical batch hashes, correction explicitly CONSUMED_CURRENT, no version switch) and test_run_daily_correction_replaces_current_publication_and_marks_correction_published (changed content -> genuinely new publication_version, correction CORRECTION_PUBLISHED). No new test was needed for the rebuild sense. For the replay sense, no existing test calls verifyRunAgainstFixture() twice against the same publication/fixture (confirmed by grep across tests/), so two new targeted tests were added to ReplayVerificationServiceTest.php: test_replaying_the_same_unchanged_publication_twice_persists_byte_identical_results_except_execution_identity calls verifyRunAgainstFixture() twice through two genuinely separate service instances and two genuinely separate Mockery mock sets (never the same object reused, never the first call's return value fed into the second as its actual), configured to represent the same stable underlying state; every persisted metric field is asserted identical between the two calls except replay_id, which is asserted to DIFFER (each independent execution mints its own identity via its own nextReplayId() expectation), proving two genuinely separate executions were compared rather than one execution compared with itself. test_a_genuine_input_divergence_between_two_independent_replays_is_detected is the falsification half: diverging one real input (bars_batch_hash) between the two independent calls moves the persisted result in exactly that field, so a constant-output implementation could not satisfy the first test by accident. The excluded-field list (only replay_id, beyond the class's own pre-existing $ignoredVolatileFields already used elsewhere in its comparison logic) is not invented: it applies the same general principle Audit_Hash_and_Reproducibility_Contract_LOCKED.md already states for artifact hashes (run_id and auto-increment navigation IDs excluded unless they alter semantics) to this new record shape. B18ReplayRerunDeterminismTest is kept unmodified as supporting evidence for exporter determinism, per this finding's own remediation point 3 -- it remains valid proof of a narrower, different claim.
